{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Tourism''' was a bureaucratic body on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Non-lethal weapons like [[Stun gun/Legends|stun guns]] were permitted on Bothawui as an exception the planet's heavy weapon restrictions but still had to be registered with the Ministry of Tourism.
